steps.content: The sea is calm. Right now, you want nothing more than to see that familiar figure break the surface.
You miss her face, the way she could soothe your troubled soul despite her clumsiness with words.
You've helped each other through so many hardships. But on this voyage, you barely spent any time together, busy with your separate duties...
You have no comms, no way to reach her. All you can do is wait.
The metal tapping has been coming from the same spot for some time, when a low exclamation breaks the silence.
Shin looks up, her lips blue from the cold. She pulls a stiff hand from where she'd tucked it for warmth and feels the air.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Yes, it is... Looks like they succeeded. They'll be back soon.
A voice suddenly comes from the other side of the room.
Laura's gaunt face peeks from under the blanket. She had received emergency treatment, but her condition hasn't improved much in just a few hours.
She groans in pain. Shin pulls back the blanket to see that the movement has reopened Laura's wound; fresh blood seeps through her clothes.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Don't speak, and try to lie still. Your bones are broken. You need to rest.
Shin gently tears clean clothing into strips and bandages the wound. As the room gets warmer, Laura's mental state improves considerably, and everyone breathes a sigh of relief.
